epic.title: Epic #567 — the door is the interface; finish the MCP migration
epic.intent_and_why: Delete the CLI-fallback paths so the MCP door is the only interface. Lane A is the anchor: you cannot delete a fallback that is currently the only path.

definition_of_done: A role agent that did not launch its own door can reach its own spine through the door.
checklist_engine.save() cannot expose a torn spine or leave a corrupt one.
The replacement isolation property is stated explicitly, with its reach delta measured.

good_enough.mandatory_quality: No silent widening of the door's security boundary; every new refusal named and tested.
good_enough.sufficient_evidence: Fresh-process tests plus a red-proof that the new tests fail against the old implementation.
good_enough.appetite: One wave, lane A of four.

hard_constraints: Assignments to SPINE/SESSION stay exactly {module scope, _bind_process_to} (module-wide AST pin).
scripts/hooks/* untouched — hooks execute from the main checkout for every live session.
_RAIL_STRINGS and _refresh_attach_hint byte-identical — lane C needs their text.
fixed_decisions: decision:convergence-is-human-only — the Commander compares; the human picks.
decision:solve-the-general-case — any role reaching its own spine, not the crew case alone.
decision:atomicity-is-not-mutual-exclusion — the atomicity fix does not address lost updates.
Launched identities remain stable: lane id cmdr-567-a, work-id epic-567-door/cmdr-a.

current_wave.objective: Unblock the epic by giving the door a path to an existing spine, and make the spine write atomic.
exit_criteria: The bind path exists and is proven on a spine the process did not mint.
save() is atomic, proven by a red-proof against the old implementation.
The reach delta is measured and stated, not asserted.

issues.useful_now: Every other lane's deletion work is blocked behind it.

issues.implementation_latitude: Mechanism inside the converged design; the design pick itself is the human's.

issues.title: save() is not atomic
issues.desired_outcome: A concurrent reader sees the complete old or complete new document; a crash cannot leave a corrupt spine.
issues.useful_now: Same seam as the identity work, and the defect is already worked around in the test suite.
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: Deterministic tests (target never write-opened; inode replaced exactly once) that FAIL against the old bare write_bytes.
issues.implementation_latitude: How much of the atomicity half is in scope.
hard_constraints_no_gos: Do NOT implement the lost-update half — no locking, no compare-and-swap.

completed_outcomes.outcome: save() writes atomically: unique mkstemp sibling, fchmod to the target's mode, flush+fsync, os.replace, temp unlinked in finally. 11 new tests.
completed_outcomes.evidence: Commander re-ran the red-proof independently: reverting save() in the worktree copy fails 5 of 11 including all three deterministic assertions; restored exactly (git diff empty); 11/11 green. 668 engine+launcher tests pass.

completed_outcomes.outcome: spine_bind(spine_file) ships: a door tool that binds this process to a spine that ALREADY EXISTS, confined to <the door's own checkout>/.agent-work/ via git rev-parse --show-toplevel plus a cross-checkout refusal on the RESOLVED path. Session derived from origin.work_id else the spine's top-level work_id, so the Admiral's own spine and IMPLEMENTER_PLAN.json both bind. Property: one checkout's work-area tree per process, enforced by path.
completed_outcomes.evidence: Commander verified in a live process: an unbound door binds a spine with origin: None and derives constellation/<work_id>, moving both identity roots and mirroring both into os.environ; six boundary attacks refused with the boundary named; the symlink escape reproduced at HEAD and refused after the fix; the legitimate case still binds. Two independent reviewers BLOCKed on the same two defects, a rework cleared both, and a narrow re-review APPROVEd after 11 symlink spellings in a real multi-checkout topology and confirming the new tests go RED against the reverted source. Full suite 3276 passed / 5 skipped / 0 failed, run independently. PR #623.

discrepancies.signal: The stated isolation property was FALSE: a symlink inside the door's own work area pointing at a nested checkout satisfied both guards, and the door wrote a live lease into another checkout's spine
discrepancies.affects: The security property this lane exists to establish
discrepancies.evidence: Two independent reviewers reproduced it; the Commander reproduced it too (first attempt failed, which revealed the real shape). Cause: R6 asked git about candidate.parent UNRESOLVED while R4 resolves. Fixed with candidate.resolve().parent; 11 spellings now refuse.
discrepancies.reason: Not a live breach (zero nested checkouts exist today) but the property as written was untrue, and stating an attackable property was the whole point of the decision. Fixed and re-reviewed.

discrepancies.signal: os.fchmod is Unix-only and was called unguarded in save(); CI is windows-latest only
discrepancies.affects: The engine on Windows, i.e. every mutating verb on the only platform CI runs
discrepancies.evidence: os.fchmod absent on Windows -> AttributeError on every save of an existing file. Found during closeout on the Admiral's warning to audit new tests for Windows hazards; no Linux run could surface it. Fixed with _restore_mode (fchmod on the FD, else os.chmod on the path); guard test runs on every platform and is proven non-vacuous.
discrepancies.reason: Fixed in-lane: bounded defect inside this lane's own file, and shipping it would have been a dead engine rather than a red test.

discrepancies.signal: A gate plan whose four command postconditions all passed at BASE with zero code written; and a mission frame that cannot satisfy its own verify-frame gate under a degraded map
discrepancies.affects: How much a green gate is worth as evidence, fleet-wide
discrepancies.evidence: Cold critic ran all four checks at 600de020: 61 passed, 456 passed, exit 0. Amended through the engine; the new checks verifiably fail at base. Separately: a five-line frame with zero anchors returns FRAME-OK exit 0 where a 15-anchor frame returns FRAME-REFUSED exit 10.
discrepancies.reason: The plan half is fixed in-lane. The verify-frame half is a triage candidate: map_orient.py is not this lane's, and it is a design question about whether a degraded frame may cite anchors backed by pinned substitutes.

discrepancies.signal: A reviewer's CORRECTION to an earlier finding was itself wrong, and the Commander propagated it without re-deriving it
discrepancies.affects: How corrections are treated versus how claims are treated
discrepancies.evidence: R2 recorded that the NUL byte kills the door 'only when already bound'; the re-review proved the unbound door dies too, via R4's refusal f-string. The Commander had adopted the narrowing into RETURN.md and notes-a.md.
discrepancies.reason: Corrected. The lesson is narrow: a run that refuses to accept reviewers' claims without re-deriving them must apply the same rule to their corrections. A correction is a claim.
